faults.fault: When widened, the background texture smears and streaks across the extra width — the speaker grille and vent areas on the left turn into stretched grey smudges instead of clean panel, and the lower carcass shows banded stretching. A player could point straight at it.

When the cabinet is made taller, the side 'SPACE WARP' decal tiles vertically — the text and ship art appear three times, doubled and mirrored mid-decal. A side decal is a single fixed sticker, not a repeating pattern; this reads as a tiling bug.

In the widened render the screen and its bezel stretch with the body instead of staying one CRT-sized unit in the centre, leaving a smeared, over-wide screen with blank bezel either side. A widened two-player cabinet keeps one screen of real size.
In the widened render the speaker grille does not appear as clean additional per-bay grilles; it shows as smeared half-stretched grille copies with ragged edges rather than a second crisp grille.

wider_means: a wider arcade cabinet is a two-player cabinet -- a second joystick and button cluster beside the first, plus the wider deck and body to carry them.
taller_means: a taller arcade cabinet has more plain lower body -- a longer bare cabinet carcass and kick area between the control deck and the floor, with the same single screen, marquee and coin door.
